additional_info.subject: ID0467747-DC/Si-D/AT-[Y2/T3314161484002] Modbus connection interrupted CRM:03056000798
additional_info.body:
Dear Johannes,
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support.
After carefully checking the charger there are no errors that appear.
After doing the new FW update, it can happen that the connection gets interrupted for a bit. This is just an effect from the software and nothing internally.
The charger looks healthy, and all outlets work fine.
If you want us to deepdive in this specific issue, please provide us with a specific time stamp, so we can check the logs.
For us it is mandatory to have a live error ongoing, to be able to see what the issue is, before doing a reboot.
Please provide us with feedback, if this answered your question, so we can close the ticket.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
